compiled_state.title: GREEN: curate affects_fields classifier fixture with 100-plus labeled examples
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description: Create tests/fixtures/affects-fields-classifier.json with 100-plus hand-labeled examples. Schema per entry: decision_text, affects_fields (array), label (high_stakes or rationale_only), source_ticket. Rules: high_stakes when affects_fields contains gate_verdicts or workflow_completion_checklist; rationale_only when affects_fields contains only rationale_text. Distribution: 50-plus high_stakes, 50-plus rationale_only. Data from PRECONDITIONS decisions_log entries in recent planning sessions; synthetic examples marked source_ticket=synthetic:<category> when insufficient real data. Accuracy verified inline in test suite (not standalone script) by checking rule alignment on each fixture entry. Acceptance: all tests in test-red-team-affects-fields-classifier.sh pass including the 95-percent accuracy gate on high_stakes class.
